Definition: Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Togarmah = "thou wilt break her"; n pr m; 1) son of Gomer, grandson of Japheth, and great grandson of Noah; n pr terr; 2) territory settled by the descendants of Togarmah; 2a) probably the area known as Armenia
